items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: That's why Walter Burton got killed up there too.

ctx.x: You hadn't started at the Apex, so you'd been up on 40. No.
They were building it, yeah. On State Street. Uh-huh. They were building the Apex, yeah. That's why Walter Burton got killed up there too.
Oh, yeah. Were these New Orleans bands more popular than the Chicago bands? Yes. Do you think the people liked them better?
